name: hubtel-application-security
description: Application security skills for Hubtel apps. Project security review: a read-only review of sessions, permissions, tenancy, and money flows. Frontend security: move Next.js and Nuxt frontends to a BFF session model, then plan and apply approved fixes for sign-in, renewal, sign-out, origin checks, CORS, CSP, unauthenticated routes, and hardcoded credentials.
